veranderings.voor: sal jy meer as 100 jaar lank besig wees
veranderings.na: sou jy meer as 100 jaar lank besig wees
veranderings.rede: The sentence continues the imagined situation opened by 'Stel jou voor', so the hypothetical 'sou' fits better than the future 'sal'.
This is a general statement about IKS, and the definite article suggests particular ancestors nobody has named yet; the general form reads more naturally.
The study text gives this definition as 'vir die mensdom of vir 'n gemeenskap'; repeating 'vir' makes the glossary entry match it exactly and makes the two parallel parts clearer.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry has a capital K, but the lesson writes 'Inheemse kennisstelsels (IKS)' and the glossary headword is 'inheemse kennisstelsels (IKS)'. In Afrikaans this is a common noun, so the lesson's lower-case form is correct. If the guard ignores case nothing needs to change, but nobody should bring the capital K into the lesson to match the entry.
